mcpFormCwdHint: Optional. If blank, workspace-scoped stdio servers start in the first trusted workspace path.
mcpFormVisibleRootsHint: Optional. Leave blank to show this server in every workspace; add paths to expose it only inside those projects.
mcpFormPlanReadOnlyTools: Plan-mode read-only tools (one name per line)
mcpFormPlanReadOnlyToolsHint: Only list tools you trust to have no side effects. Remote MCP read-only annotations are not treated as authorization.
mcpFormErrorCommandRequired: Command is required for a local (stdio) server.
mcpFormErrorUrlRequired: URL is required for an HTTP or SSE server.
mcpFormErrorUrlInvalid: URL must start with http:// or https://.
mcpFormErrorWorkspaceRoots: Add at least one workspace path, or switch trust scope to All workspaces.
mcpFileStatusReady: The current content was loaded from the config file.
mcpFileStatusMissing: The config file does not exist yet. It will be created on first save.
mcpRuntimeHint: If saved changes do not take effect, restart the local assistant service or reopen the app.
apiKeyDesc: Required. Chats, Work, and phone connections use this by default.
apiKeySharedDesc: Required. Chats, Work, and phone connections use this by default.
baseUrlDesc: Default model service endpoint. Leave empty to use the official DeepSeek endpoint.
baseUrlSharedDesc: Default model service endpoint. Leave empty to use the official DeepSeek endpoint.
proxyUrlDesc: Route model-service HTTP requests through a local proxy. Entering a port uses http://127.0.0.1:<port>.
proxyUrlInvalid: Enter a local proxy port from 1 to 65535, or turn the proxy off.
firstRunTitle: Set up the essentials before you start chatting.
firstRunSubtitle: Choose your language and model provider, then add the matching API key.
firstRunPermissionFullAccessRisk: "Full access" lets Kun access any local file, execute host commands, and use network-capable tools without Kun approval. Choose it only for trusted tasks and input.
firstRunKeyHintXiaomiApi: Create a pay-as-you-go API key (sk- prefix) in the Xiaomi MiMo platform console.
firstRunKeyHintXiaomiTokenPlan: Get a Token Plan key (tp- prefix) from the Xiaomi subscription page. Plan keys and API keys are not interchangeable.
firstRunKeyHintMinimaxApi: Get a pay-as-you-go API key from the MiniMax platform's interface keys page.
firstRunKeyHintMinimaxTokenPlan: Get a subscription key from MiniMax Token Plan management. Plan keys and API keys are not interchangeable.
firstRunAutoWireSpeech: Voice input (speech to text) will be enabled automatically after saving. You can adjust it in Settings anytime.
firstRunAutoWireImage: Image generation will be enabled automatically after saving. You can adjust it in Settings anytime.
firstRunTokenPlanNoSpeech: Speech to text only works with pay-as-you-go API keys; plan keys are not accepted. Add an API key too if you want voice input.
firstRunTokenPlanNoImage: This provider's Token Plan is not configured for image generation. Add a pay-as-you-go API key too if you want images.
firstRunChangeLater: You can change these values anytime from Settings after the workbench opens.
firstRunPreviewHint: This reuses the first-launch flow; unsaved theme previews are restored when you close it.
firstRunBuyApiHint: Don't have an API key yet? Visit DeepSeek's official platform to buy official API access, then come back here to paste it in.
firstRunApiKeyValidation: Please enter the {{provider}} API key before continuing.
firstRunCredentialRecoveryError: Windows can no longer decrypt Kun's saved credentials.
firstRunCredentialRecoveryDetail: Retry if this may be temporary. Resetting first backs up the unreadable data, then signs out saved API keys and OAuth connections. Conversations, workspaces, and ordinary settings are kept.
autoStartDesc: Recommended. The app starts the local assistant service automatically when chats, Work, or phone connections need it.
corsOriginsDesc: Additional allowed Origin values for the local HTTP server.
toolPermissionModeDesc: Controls tool confirmation and local permissions together. Changes apply on the next turn.
toolPermissionAskForApprovalDesc: Uses the workspace boundary. Safe actions run directly; approval-worthy writes, commands, network, and external effects wait for your decision.
toolPermissionApproveForMeDesc: Uses the same workspace boundary. The model selected for the acting turn reviews approval-worthy actions in a separate no-tools call; failure denies the action.
toolPermissionFullAccessDesc: Runs without Kun approval and can access any local file, execute host commands, and use network-capable tools.
permissionsBehaviorHint: Ask for approval sends approval-worthy actions to you. Approve for me sends the same actions to an isolated reviewer using the model selected for that turn and fails closed. Full access bypasses Kun approval and grants unrestricted local execution.
designQualityHint: After the agent writes or edits a frontend file (HTML/CSS/JSX/TSX/SVG), Kun automatically scans for AI-generated design tells and craft issues (purple-blue gradients, cream default backgrounds, bounce easing, nested cards, contrast, line length, missing reduced-motion, etc.) and folds the findings back to the model so it self-corrects on the next turn.
designQualityEnableDesc: On by default. When off, writing/editing frontend files runs no design-quality scan.
designQualityStrictnessDesc: Relaxed: only the most reliable AI tells. Standard: tells + general craft issues. Strict: adds heuristic rules (broader coverage, occasional false positives).
computerUseHint: Lets the agent see your screen and move the mouse / type on your behalf. It controls your real computer — enable only when you intend to supervise it, and you can stop a run at any time.
computerUseModelQualityBody: Chinese-mainland multimodal models (MiniMax, Qwen-VL, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, etc.) currently struggle with screenshot-driven visual grounding and multi-step desktop control — they often click the wrong target, fail to spot the icon they need, or trigger upstream 502s and cannot reliably complete a host-control task. For real use, prefer Claude (Sonnet / Opus vision) or GPT-class vision models; treat the domestic models as experimental for now.
computerUseEnableDesc: Registers the computer_use tool so the agent can take screenshots and drive the mouse and keyboard.
computerUseModeDesc: Auto exposes the tool only to vision (image-capable) models, which decide for themselves when to use it. Always exposes it to every model. Off keeps it registered but hidden.
browserUseSettingsHint: Gives Kun a temporary first-party browser for structured page reading. It is separate from screen control and the developer preview.
browserUseZeroTrustBody: Policy-vetted public origins and low-risk interactions run automatically. Local development and Always ask mode require approval. Credentials, payments, MFA, CAPTCHA, uploads, downloads, clipboard, cookies, storage, selectors, and scripts stay blocked.
browserUseSettingsEnableDesc: Enabled by default. Turning it off restarts the managed Kun runtime and removes the browser_use tool.
browserUseSettingsPublicDesc: Allows only publicly routable HTTP(S) destinations. Private, loopback, link-local, metadata, and mixed DNS answers fail closed.
browserUseSettingsLocalDesc: Allows only an explicitly approved exact localhost/loopback origin for development. It never mixes with public destinations.
browserUseSettingsApprovalModeDesc: Automatically opens policy-vetted public pages and executes validated low-risk interactions.
browserUseSettingsApprovalAlwaysAskDesc: Requires an exact-origin decision and target-specific one-time approval for each interaction.
browserUseSettingsMaxTabsDesc: Hard session cap. Popups remain blocked.
browserUseSettingsObservationBudgetDesc: Maximum snapshots, screenshots, waits, and navigation operations per turn.
browserUseSettingsInteractionBudgetDesc: Maximum click, type, select, and press operations per turn.
browserUseSettingsSnapshotDetailDesc: Bounds structured nodes, visible text, and screenshot dimensions sent to the model.
browserUseSettingsIdleTimeoutDesc: Automatically destroys the temporary browser and clears storage after inactivity.
computerUsePermissionsDesc: macOS requires Accessibility (for mouse/keyboard) and Screen Recording (for screenshots). Grant both, then re-check.
computerUseRestartHint: Accessibility is enabled in System Settings, but macOS only applies it after the app restarts. Fully quit Kun and reopen it, then re-check.
autoApplyBlocked: Fix the port to apply changes
workspaceRootDesc: First launch uses ~/.kun/default_workspace by default, and you can change it to another directory.
conversationWorkspaceRootDesc: Conversations that are not bound to a project create a timestamped subfolder under this directory as their working directory.
writeWorkspaceRootDesc: Work edits Markdown and TXT here and opens PDF, Office documents, and images as read-only previews. A welcome.md file is created on first launch.
writeAutoSaveDesc: When enabled, editable Markdown and TXT files in Work are saved to disk after editing pauses. Turn it off to save manually with the save button or shortcut.
writeAutoSaveDelayDesc: Save after editing has stopped for this many seconds; range {{min}} seconds to {{max}} minutes.
writeFontPresetDesc: Body font for the Work editor — pick a comfortable face for long documents.
writeFontSizeDesc: Body text size ({{min}}–{{max}}px). Applies to the editor and preview.
writeLineHeightDesc: Body line height — larger values add more breathing room.
writeTypographyResetDesc: Restore the default font, size, and spacing.
writeAgentPresetsDesc: Configure dedicated agents for long-form writing — each agent is a persona/behavior prompt (e.g. plot coordinator, line editor, foreshadowing tracker, continuity checker). Switch between them from the selection popover in the editor. Off by default; add what you need.
writeAgentPersonaPlaceholder: Describe this agent's persona, role, and behavior rules…
writeInlineCompletionEnabledDesc: Show gray continuation suggestions in the Markdown editor that you can accept with Tab.
writeInlineCompletionRetrievalDesc: Before generating a suggestion, quickly reference Markdown files in the Work space so terminology, facts, and writing style stay consistent.
writeInlineCompletionProviderDesc: Leave this inherited to use the AI assistant provider, or choose another configured provider for writing suggestions.
writeInlineCompletionBaseUrlDesc: Writing suggestions use the Basics service URL by default. Fill this only if writing should connect to a different service.
writeInlineCompletionBaseUrlInherited: Currently using the Basics service URL: {{value}}
writeInlineCompletionBaseUrlOverride: Currently using a writing-specific service URL: {{value}}
writeInlineCompletionApiKeyDesc: Optional. Leave empty to inherit the General API key; fill this only when Work should use a different key.
writeInlineCompletionApiKeyInherited: Currently inheriting the General API key.
writeInlineCompletionApiKeyMissing: No General API key is configured yet.
writeInlineCompletionApiKeyOverride: Currently using a writing-only API key.
writeInlineCompletionModelDesc: Leave this empty to use the assistant's default model. Fill it only if writing suggestions need their own model.
writeInlineCompletionModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to use assistant model
writeInlineCompletionDebounceDesc: How long the editor waits after typing stops before showing a suggestion. Shorter is more responsive; longer is quieter and saves requests.
writeInlineCompletionThresholdDesc: Controls how often suggestions appear. Stricter settings show fewer, steadier suggestions.
writeInlineCompletionMaxTokensDesc: Higher numbers allow longer suggestions. Keep this short so suggestions feel like the next few lines, not a full draft.
writeInlineLongCompletionDesc: When the cursor rests longer at a line end or paragraph boundary, show a fuller next sentence or paragraph idea.
writeInlineLongCompletionMaxTokensDesc: Controls the maximum length for paragraph inspiration suggestions, best for about one paragraph of continuation.
writeInlineCompletionApiNote: These settings only affect automatic writing suggestions in Work. Provider credentials are configured in Providers. Press Tab to accept and Esc to hide.
writeDebugLogDesc: View recent writing suggestion requests and responses to understand why suggestions did not appear or felt off.
writeDebugLogModalDesc: Inspect the context sent for writing suggestions, raw model responses, and parsed output.
writeInlineEditDebugDesc: Inspect recent writing edit calls, including what was sent to the model, the raw response, and the parsed action, so it is easier to tell whether a problem came from the request, model output, or app handling.
writeInlineEditDebugEmpty: No text edit calls yet. Run AI Edit on a selection and the calls will appear here.
writeCompletionDebugEmpty: No writing suggestion calls yet. Trigger a writing suggestion and the calls will appear here.
writeApiKeyDesc: Writing completion and the Work assistant inherit the General API key unless a Work override is set.
apiKeyRequiredBody: Add an API key in Providers first. Once entered, the app can start the local AI assistant service for you.
guiUpdateChannelDesc: Stable is the default; Frontier is only used after you switch to it. Stable only receives formal stable releases.
guiUpdateDesc: Check the selected release channel for GUI updates, then download and install in the app.
guiUpdateCheckFailed: Could not check for GUI updates
guiUpdateErrNotConfigured: Update checking isn't available right now.
guiUpdateErrUnsupported: This build does not support in-app automatic updates. Open the download page to install manually.
guiUpdateErrRepoNotFound: The update source «{{repo}}» wasn't found or isn't reachable on GitHub.
guiUpdateErrForbidden: Couldn't fetch update information. Try again later.
guiUpdateErrRateLimit: Too many requests. Try again later.
guiUpdateErrNoStableVersion: No stable release or tag to compare yet (for example v0.1.0). Repo: {{repo}}.
guiUpdateAvailableManual: New version available: {{current}} → {{latest}}. Install it from the download page.
guiUpdateDownloadedDesc: Restart the app to install the new version.
logDirDesc: App error logs and local assistant service output are written to daily files in this folder.
logEnabledDesc: Write tool call errors, request failures, app errors, and local assistant service output to log files. Logs are cleaned up automatically.
logRetentionDesc: Delete log files older than the selected number of days.
checkpointCreateEnabled: Create Git checkpoints when sending messages
checkpointCreateEnabledDesc: When enabled, snapshot the workspace before each send so you can roll back. Off by default to avoid disk growth.
checkpointCleanupEnabledDesc: When enabled, run cleanup on the retention schedule. App startup and version upgrades always run retention cleanup once (this toggle does not block them).
checkpointCleanupIntervalDesc: Delete checkpoint history older than this many days, remove unreferenced directories, and enforce the per-chat cap. Forced on startup/upgrade. Default 3 days.
checkpointDirectoryDesc: Custom location for Git checkpoints (point it at another drive to avoid filling the system drive). Leave blank to use the default data dir/git-checkpoints.
checkpointMaxPerThreadDesc: Keep at most this many checkpoints per chat; older ones are deleted automatically (even if a message still references them — those rollbacks show as expired). Default 5.
checkpointMaxTotalBytesDesc: Hard cap on total checkpoint disk usage. Oldest checkpoints are removed first when the cap is exceeded; new checkpoints are skipped when it cannot be met. Default 2048 MB.
checkpointMinFreeDiskBytesDesc: Skip creating checkpoints when the checkpoint disk has less free space than this. Default 1024 MB.
preloadBridgeError: The app bridge is not available. Restart the application or check the preload path.
uiModeWorkshopDesc: Pick the workspace mascot pack. The built-in iKun mode is itself a pre-installed UI plugin example — build and install your own packs with the developer guide (declarative image packs, no executable code).
uiPaletteRetromaOn: Retroma palette on — click to use default palette
uiPluginEmpty: No UI plugins installed. The bundled iKun example may have been removed; install a plugin folder, or build one with the developer guide.
uiPluginCharacterScaleDesc: Adjust the active character relative to its pack default. Kun remembers each pack separately.
gitBranchPrefixDesc: Prefix branch names created from the branch picker. Leave blank to create names exactly as entered.
worktreeOverviewDesc: View Git worktrees checked out from conversations and clean up worktree directories you no longer need.
worktreeEmptyList: No conversation worktrees for the current project yet.
worktreeForceConfirm: This worktree has {{count}} uncommitted change(s). Force-reset will discard them. Continue?
worktreeNotGitRepo: The current workspace is not a Git repository. Worktrees require a Git project — please select one in General settings.
memoryOverviewDesc: Memory records persist facts and preferences across sessions. They are injected into the assistant's context automatically and can be edited here.
memoryRecordsDesc: Create, edit, disable or delete memory records. Changes take effect on the next turn.
memoryExportUnavailable: Memory export is unavailable in this environment.
memoryImportStepPrompt: Copy this prompt into another AI chat
memoryImportStepPaste: Paste the result below and add it to Kun memory
memoryImportTargetPathPlaceholder: Absolute path to the workspace or project directory
memoryImportUserScopeHint: User memories are available across workspaces.
memoryImportTargetRequired: Choose a workspace / project path before importing.
memoryImportPartialSuffix: . Check the runtime error and retry.
memoryImportAllDuplicate: No new memories to import; every parsed item already exists.
memoryImportInvalidPortable: This Kun Memory V2 archive is invalid or unsupported.
memoryImportPortableScopeHint: Portable records keep their original scope and target path.
memorySaveFailed: Save failed. Make sure memory is enabled, or check the runtime error and retry.
memoryEmpty: No memory records yet. The assistant will create them automatically as it learns your preferences, or add one manually.
memoryContentPlaceholder: What should the assistant remember? e.g. "Prefer TypeScript with 2-space indentation."
memoryTargetPathPlaceholder: Absolute path to the workspace or project directory
memoryLastInjectedDesc: Memory record IDs that were injected into the most recent turn.
memoryBackfillDesc: Canonical memory files are being projected into the local search index.
memoryDisabledHint: Memory is currently disabled. Enable it in the runtime configuration (kun config) to create and use memory records.
memoryEnableDesc: When enabled, the assistant persists facts and preferences across sessions and injects them into context automatically. Changes apply on the next turn.
codexEndpointLocked: ChatGPT subscription uses a fixed endpoint and cannot be changed.
claudeEndpointLocked: Claude subscription uses a fixed endpoint and cannot be changed.
geminiEndpointLocked: Gemini subscription turns are handed entirely to the official Antigravity CLI; HTTP endpoint settings do not apply.
geminiSubscriptionNote: Uses Google's official Antigravity CLI and its existing Google subscription login.
geminiSubscriptionLimitations: Each chat turn is handed entirely to that CLI. Kun tools, MCP servers, and Kun's normal agent prompt/tool setup are not inherited here. If you need Kun-managed tools, MCP, and long-session history, use Gemini CLI subscription (API) instead.
geminiCliApiEndpointLocked: The Gemini CLI subscription uses the official Gemini CLI Code Assist API contract directly through Kun; its endpoint is fixed.
geminiCliApiSubscriptionNote: Reuses the official Google Gemini CLI OAuth login and Code Assist API directly. Kun owns long-session history, tools, and compaction here; this model catalog is separate from Antigravity whole-turn delegation.
geminiCliApiReady: Gemini CLI Google login is ready
geminiCliApiLoginRequired: Gemini CLI is not signed in to Google
geminiCliApiLoginHint: Run `gemini` in a terminal, choose “Login with Google”, then return here and check again.
geminiCliApiInstallHint: Install the official Google Gemini CLI and sign in. Kun reads that OAuth login without copying credentials into settings.
geminiCliApiStatusFailed: Could not inspect the Gemini CLI login.
geminiCliApiModelsSyncFailed: Could not read the Gemini CLI API model catalog.
cursorEndpointLocked: Cursor subscription turns use the official Cursor SDK; HTTP endpoint settings do not apply.
cursorSubscriptionNote: Enter an API key created in the Cursor dashboard. Kun uses the official Cursor SDK and never requires the Cursor desktop app or reads its local login.
cursorSubscriptionRestartRequired: Kun's main process is still running an older version. Fully quit Kun and reopen it, then test the connection again.
geminiModelsSyncFailed: Could not read Antigravity subscription models. Sign in to Antigravity first.
claudeExtraUsageNotice: Third-party apps draw from your Extra Usage balance, not your plan limits. Make sure Extra Usage is enabled and funded at claude.ai/settings/usage.
codexBrowserOpened: Browser opened. Complete the sign-in to return automatically.
codexEnterCode: Open the link below and enter the code to authorize:
codexLoginPortBusyFallback: Local callback ports 1455 and 1457 are in use, so device-code sign-in is ready instead.
grokEndpointLocked: Grok subscription uses a fixed cli-chat-proxy endpoint and cannot be changed.
grokBrowserOpened: Browser opened. Complete the sign-in to return automatically.
grokPasteCodeHint: If the browser shows a code (or a callback URL), paste it below to finish sign-in — same as Grok Build.
grokPasteCodePlaceholder: Paste authorization code or callback URL
grokAuthErrorDiscovery: Grok sign-in could not reach the authentication service. Check the global proxy setting and network, then retry.
grokAuthErrorBrowserOpen: Windows could not open the system browser. Check the default browser association, then retry.
grokAuthErrorCallback: Grok sign-in could not start or validate the local callback. Check local firewall rules and retry.
grokAuthErrorTokenExchange: Grok returned to Kun, but the authorization code could not be exchanged. Check the global proxy and retry.
grokAuthErrorTimeout: Grok authorization timed out. Retry the login and complete it within ten minutes.
memoryDisableConfirmDetail: The assistant will stop using this memory. You can restore it later.
memoryDeleteConfirmDetail: Deleted memories are removed from this list and cannot be restored here.
dataMigrationSubtitle: Move Kun workspaces, conversations, and portable app data between computers with a single package.
dataMigrationScopeBody: Select the workspaces and data categories to include. Kun estimates the package size before creating it.
dataMigrationSecurityBody: Encrypted packages are recommended, especially when conversations or workspace files may contain private information.
dataMigrationPresetCompleteBody: Include all selected data for the closest possible copy of this computer.
dataMigrationPresetSmallerBody: Reduce caches and regenerable data to make the package easier to transfer.
dataMigrationPassphraseOptional: At least 8 characters, or leave blank
dataMigrationUnencryptedAck: I understand that this package will not be encrypted and anyone who obtains it may read its contents.
dataMigrationNoPasswordRecovery: Kun cannot recover a forgotten package passphrase.
dataMigrationSensitiveAck: The scan found {{count}} potentially sensitive item(s). I reviewed the selected scope and want to continue.
dataMigrationRunningInterrupt: Interrupt and include their latest saved state
dataMigrationExportReviewBody: Confirm the scope, destination, and security before Kun writes the package.
dataMigrationChooseOutput: Choose where to save the .kunpack file
dataMigrationSelectBody: Choose a .kunpack file created by Kun. The package is validated before anything on this computer changes.
dataMigrationInspectBody: Review the source system, included content, and package size before choosing destinations.
dataMigrationMapBody: Kun converts portable package paths into native paths for this computer. Choose a base folder for imported workspaces.
dataMigrationResolveBody: Choose how to handle each destination and any file-level conflicts detected there.
dataMigrationKeepBoth: Keep both in a new folder
dataMigrationImportReviewBody: Kun will stage and validate the full import before switching destinations. Imported trust and automation remain disabled.
dataMigrationTrustResetNotice: Workspace trust, approvals, scheduled tasks, and imported workflows are not activated automatically. Review them on this computer first.
dataMigrationFeatureDisabled: Data migration is disabled in this build.
dataMigrationRecoveryBody: The previous operation stopped during {{phase}}. Current destination effect: {{effect}}.
